# Learn Meta Ads

> Free animated lessons on Meta ads: how the auction picks ads, creative strategy, media buying, measurement and the weekly routine of a great Meta advertiser. Free, no sign-up. Written by Brett G. Friedman, Founder, The Creative Strategy Agency (TCSA).

Independent guide, not affiliated with or endorsed by Meta Platforms, Inc. Numbers labelled "Example numbers" are made up for teaching; "Meta says" lines link Meta's own documentation.

## Foundations

- [How creative wins on Meta](https://learnmetaads.com/how-creative-wins/): One feed seat at a time: the auction, the chain from hook to sale, and why the number of real shots decides how many winners you get.
- [The numbers behind a sale](https://learnmetaads.com/the-numbers/): CPM, click-through rate, conversion rate and cost per purchase are one chain. Learn to read it and find the link that broke.
- [What you can afford to pay](https://learnmetaads.com/what-you-can-pay/): Margin, breakeven ROAS and lifetime value set the ceiling on every result you buy.

## Creative strategy

- [Concepts: who, what and why](https://learnmetaads.com/concepts/): Awareness levels, angles and the concept grid that turns one product into dozens of genuinely different ads.
- [Hooks and the anatomy of an ad](https://learnmetaads.com/hooks/): The first seconds decide everything after them. How the hook, body and offer each earn the next second.
- [Iterate, explore, refresh](https://learnmetaads.com/iterate-and-refresh/): Read what won, make more of it, keep swinging at new ideas, and replace ads before they wear out.

## Media buying

- [Account structure and learning](https://learnmetaads.com/account-structure/): Campaigns, ad sets and ads, why fewer ad sets learn faster, and which edits send an ad set back to learning.
- [Budgets, bids and scaling](https://learnmetaads.com/budgets-bids-scaling/): Bid strategies, why the next dollar buys less than the last, and how to grow spend without wrecking cost per result.
- [Testing without fooling yourself](https://learnmetaads.com/testing/): Small numbers lie. How much data a verdict needs, and simple rules for cutting and keeping ads.

## Measurement and the weekly rhythm

- [Tracking and attribution](https://learnmetaads.com/tracking-attribution/): Pixel, Conversions API, attribution windows, and the gap between the sales Meta counts and the sales your ads caused.
- [The weekly playbook](https://learnmetaads.com/weekly-playbook/): Everything in one weekly rhythm: read the numbers, read the creative, brief, launch, and keep the account healthy.

## Practice

- [Taste Maker](https://thecreativetastemaker.com/): a free game where you call real ads as winners or losers.
- [The Creative Strategy Agency](https://thecreativestrategyagency.com/): the agency behind the course.
